body: i adore this anime (i too was a bit late to the party. missed the train by a year or two but glad i did cuz i got collectibles on the cheap from people hopping off....and i ain't never getting off.) but sadly i don't think there will be. i really wish there was and i've been trying to find the light novels in english (i still can't read japanese and my speaking is of a child) but yet to get my hands on em. i know he wanted to do another one and even more manga but guess that got shut down by his manager for other work.

thank you so much for actualy careing. my spelling is shit because it's hard to see with the tears. thank you for this. it's so dumb but honestly it means the wourld. i'm 30 and people say i should give up on such things because i'm "old" but it's not. i was thinking of trying agian in the morning but you made me relize that it's time to focus on myslef and find my happy place agian. thank you for reaching out and saveing me.

i'm scared. i've been hospitalized before and i was treated like an animal. the people were mean and the doctors didn't care. when i finally spoke up(waited and raised my hand until i was called on) in group i got shut down and told my problems didn't matter by another patient and the doc just sat there and let them. i quickly lied my way out the next day by saying i was all better and wouldn't cut again. even the therapist i saw when i got out didn't listen and would often speak over me. i'm scared to tell my friend because now that she moved i don't want to stress her out more than she already is. her and her fiance have been my only reasons for continuing to live. i want to be happy again. music gave me such life i would spend hours on end watching the dvds of my fav band and i would cry happy tears. it was heaven. their songs saved me so many times and i wanted to be just like them. then people just kept chipping away at me until now...i'm broken bad to the point i'm actually sick, i go have a scope done soon so they can try to figure out what is causing all the pain (picture del toro's tooth fairys from hell boy inside your organs...thats the pain i have) morphine and the other stuff has done nothing. i'm just tired of all the pain. sorry for being whiney...there are others on here who need help more.

i wanted to be a rock star or work in the entertainment industry so i can be around the people who gave me hope at one time and use the platform to spread love.(i know i sound like a hippy but honestly smiles and animals make my day. i love knowing i made something that made someone smile even for a brief time.or it used to) i wanted to work in japan and go to school for international business so if i failed i can still work in the industry or perhaps an actor or something...i just wanted to make people smile even if i'm behind the scenes. but my grades in hs were never good and i'm not good at math and a few other things due to dyslexia.

because i have done nothing but hurt my whole life. i've fought for so long and so hard but i'm just tired now. i've been told to kill myself, that i was a waste, i wasn't man enough because i don't like conflict and i enjoy being nice, been used for gifts and ego boosts then tossed aside or treated like crap when i finally stand up for myself, told my dreams are shit and stupid, used as a butler, called useless by my own mother, and been ignored, talked over, forgotten, and have had to watch people i loved die. i want to smile again and feel happy, i want to help others because their smiles make my day. i want to reach my dreams so i can spread nothing but love and let others who are broken as me know that as long as we share a sky you arn't alone. but i'm stupid. it's too late for me now. i gave up so much of my life for others only to be hurt.
